lessons.proposer: Emit at most one planning think, then execute the pick-move-drop cycle continuously with no further think steps; avoid emitting duplicate actions per step, and verify the step budget (roughly 3*ceil(N/2) plus travel) is sufficient before starting so the final pair is dropped before the limit.
lessons.checker: Track the remaining step budget against the number of objects left; if the per-object transfer cycle is too slow, push the proposer to optimize (e.g., verify whether more than two objects can be carried or whether travel can be reduced) rather than endorsing the same slow cycle.
lessons.finalizer: Execute the concrete pick/move/drop actions directly and continuously without any think steps or duplicate commands; track remaining objects and keep cycling until all are delivered, since each redundant action consumes budget needed for the final transfers.
